# Copilot Instructions

## Environment
- The project uses a virtual environment located at `.venv`.
- Always activate the virtual environment (`source .venv/bin/activate`) or use the binary paths directly (e.g. `.venv/bin/python`, `.venv/bin/pytest`) when running commands.

## Testing
- The project uses `pytest` for testing.
- Run all tests using `pytest`.
- Run specific tests using `pytest tests/test_file.py`.
- Ensure new code includes appropriate tests in the `tests/` directory.
